lex: MotorSport Vision is the operating organisation for Bedford Aerodrome in Thurleigh (postal code: MK44). It was founded by Peter Ogden.
Peter Ogden is the founder of MotorSport Vision which operates the Bedford Aerodrome in Thurleigh, whose postal code is MK44.
